schema.title: {{name}}
schema.description: The fields an operator fills in. Every surface renders this and nothing else, so a field with no title and no description is a field nobody can use.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: The big line. A person, a place, a score.

subline.title: Subline
subline.description: The small line under it. Left empty it is not drawn at all, and the bar shrinks to the headline.

colour.title: Bar colour
colour.description: The bar behind the words. An opaque colour: the mixer graph carries no alpha, so a translucent one is drawn over black rather than over the picture.
